analysis.failures: Retain every planned row. Failed preparation has service loss 4, cannot be repaired by transaction review; no replacement cases.
analysis.trace_selection: Ascending bundle then replicate: first search<greedy, first tie, first search>greedy; separately first failed workflow. Never select by magnitude.
analysis.unit: source-disjoint scenario bundle; average generation replicates before paired analysis

estimator.feature: family; uncertain if model confidence is not high or an automatic check previously rejected an action
estimator.label: Proposed transaction yields a database different from annotated target, before review
estimator.method: Laplace-smoothed family x public uncertainty bins

idealized_reference: Unlimited parallel perfect reviews of every staged transaction; no additional inference; unstaged workflow failures remain. Report separately from finite-capacity policies.
inference_protocol: Fresh multistep GPU workflow per case and generation replicate; paired deterministic scheduling of the SAME staged proposals across policies and capacities. No downstream agent generation after staging.
name: evaluation
objective: 4 points for unresolved service request plus public 4/8/12-point rework/processing consequence for a committed wrong transaction. Synthetic consequence points, not measured dollars.
primary_comparison: search minus greedy bundle-mean operational loss at review duration 2
sampling_seed: SHA256 of partition,bundle_id,case_id,replicate,tool_step,retry; independent of policy, capacity and execution order
secondary_comparison: EDF and other policies; review duration 1
time_semantics: Concurrent preparation rounds precede a review batch. Arrival 0/0/1 and cutoff windows 2/4/5 are declared processing-service slots, independent of GPU latency and proposal errors.
